settings.heading: Designed with you, to last for your eternity

settings.content: An independent London jewellery house — engagement and wedding rings, eternity rings, fine jewellery and bespoke commissions. Ethically made, honestly explained, fairly priced.

settings.heading: Why we started
settings.intro:
For Your Eternity began in 2024 out of a simple frustration: buying fine jewellery shouldn't feel like being sold to. Too much mystique, too much mark-up, too little straight talk. We wanted a jeweller that explains rather than pressures — where the person you speak to is the person who designs your piece.

We began with engagement and wedding rings, and today we work across the whole of fine jewellery: eternity rings, pendants, earrings, bespoke commissions, and remodelling pieces you already own into something you'll actually wear.
settings.quote: Exceptional quality, ethical craftsmanship — and prices better than the high street.

settings.image_alt: Edward Marno, founder of For Your Eternity, on a rooftop with the London skyline behind him
settings.caption: Edward Marno, founder.
settings.heading: Meet Edward
settings.intro:
I'm Edward, and I run For Your Eternity. Every consultation, every stone, every quote — that's me. It means you get one person who knows your piece from the first conversation to the day it's collected.

We start by talking: what you like, what gets worn day to day, what you want to spend. Then I explain the trade-offs honestly until the decision feels obvious. Natural or lab-grown, 1.5ct or 0.7ct, platinum or gold — there's no wrong answer, only the right one for you.

And I'm still the one you call in five years, when it needs a clean, a resize, or a matching band. That's rather the point.
